proposals.evidence: DEDR827 gives Kannada ede/edde chest/breast/courage and Tulu ede heart/chest, with Telugu eda heart. Kudiya ede, Badaga etə and Betta Kurumba yaddi are proposed comparative heart/chest-family variants, preserving initial glide, dental voicing and source sense. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR839 gives Malayalam eluvu/eluṅku, Kannada elu/eluvu/elugu/emike/emake and Toda eḷf bone. Selected survey yeḷuvā/eḷuku/yelɨyɨ/yemke/yāmukɨ/yellu and Toda eṛḷf are comparative variants preserving source initial glides, vowels and lateral notation; the śelugū form is excluded pending an explanation of its initial consonant. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Selected netter-/nettr-/naṭṭr-type survey responses preserve that stem with vowel variation or syncope; opaque Gondi naktur/naktar responses are excluded pending stronger consonant evidence. proposals.evidence: DEDR621 gives Irula uddya long, Kannada udda/uddi/uddu length or height, Kodagu uddatë long and Tulu udda long. Survey uddā/vuḍḍā/uddu/utta/uddaṭā long preserve that family, including the initial glide and ordinary final-vowel or adjectival variation; longer opaque elicitation responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
